number_format: a value with no fractional part is written as an integer, else the shortest decimal that reads back the same (no exponent in these vectors); lines are compact JSON (no spaces) with m keys in 9.1 order
about: snapshots are processed in order, per relay, with the last accepted seq and receive time carried; a refused snapshot changes nothing; checks in the order of checks; raw lines drop null values; a bucket is written when a snapshot for a later bucket arrives (the last bucket of each relay is still open); stats are [min, mean, max, sum, last] over the bucket's non-null values, n the snapshots in it; hourly lines come from the hour's raw snapshots; query points are raw values (1h) or the bucket's mean (now) or sum (interval); aggregate=1 groups by floor(t / step) * step and sums, averages (mean) or takes the maximum (max); at most 800 points, the latest kept

exposition.about: families in order: lucid_console_info, lucid_relay_up, lucid_relay_last_contact_seconds (seconds since last_contact_ms), lucid_relay_health, then one family per 9.1 key in 9.1 order (license_state then license_service last, as state sets; license_service states stopped, on, grace, upgrade-period for codes 0 to 3); relays in registry order in each family; labels relay, name, site, product, then state; gauges carry the latest accepted value (no sample for null), counters the sum of every accepted interval value; latency in seconds (value / 1000); state sets list every state, 1 for the current one
